items.source: Return the registered CorsConfiguration objects, keyed by path pattern.
items.translation: 返回已注册的按路径模式键索引的CorsConfiguration对象。

items.source: By default, the CorsConfiguration for this mapping is initialized with default values as described in CorsConfiguration.applyPermitDefaultValues().
items.translation: 默认情况下，此映射的 CorsConfiguration 会根据 CorsConfiguration.applyPermitDefaultValues() 中描述的默认值进行初始化。

items.source: Exact path mapping URIs (such as "/admin") are supported as well as Ant-style path patterns (such as "/admin/**").
items.translation: 精确路径映射 URI（例如 `"/admin"）也得到支持，同时还支持 Ant 风格的路径模式（例如 `"/admin/**"）。

items.source: Assists with the registration of global, URL pattern based CorsConfiguration mappings.
items.translation: 协助注册基于全局 URL 模式的 CorsConfiguration 映射。

items.source: Enable cross-origin request handling for the specified path pattern.
items.translation: 为指定的路径模式启用跨域请求处理。
